entities.summary: Kaocen Revolt (Tuareg Uprising), a transformative movement in Niger (1916–1917). Emerged from Kaocen Revolt 1916 and Voulet-Chanoine Expedition. Catalyzed Tuareg and Niger as AOF Territory.
